title: Jellyfin Merge Proxy
description: Client traffic, upstream health, streaming, merge/dedupe, cache, auth, config/TLS and process metrics for jellyfin-merge-proxy. Generated by `cargo xtask dashboard`; see METRICS.md.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Client HTTP requests per second handled by the proxy (all routes).

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of client responses with a 5xx status. 0 when nothing failed. Orange from 1 %, red from 5 %.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile time until response headers, all routes (for streams this excludes the body transfer). Orange from 500 ms, red from 2 s.

panels.title: Upstreams down
panels.description: Configured upstream servers currently in back-off (failed health checks). Servers removed or disabled by a reload are not counted. Red when any is down.

targets.expr: count((jmp_upstream_up{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} and on(instance, server) jmp_upstream_configured{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} == 1) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active streams
panels.description: Response bodies being streamed right now (video, HLS, images, downloads).

panels.title: Stream throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second streamed from upstreams to clients.

panels.title: Client sessions
panels.description: Proxy login sessions (issued access tokens).

panels.title: Next cert expiry
panels.description: Days until the first loaded TLS certificate (listener or upstream client/CA) expires. Orange under 14 days, red under 7. Empty when TLS is not used.

panels.title: Upstream health
panels.description: Health of each configured upstream over time: green = healthy, red = in back-off after failed checks. A server removed or disabled by a reload stops at the reload (no bar), it is not shown as down.

targets.expr: max by (server) (jmp_upstream_up{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} and on(instance, server) jmp_upstream_configured{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} == 1)

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Client responses per second, stacked by HTTP status class.

panels.title: Top routes
panels.description: Request rate of the 8 busiest route templates over the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (rate(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(route) topk(8, sum by (route) (increase(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Client request latency (time to response headers) as a heatmap of histogram buckets: darker = more requests.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: p50 / p90 / p99 client latency (time to response headers).

panels.title: Proxy errors by kind
panels.description: Requests the proxy itself failed, by error kind (unauthorized, not_found, upstream_unavailable, upstream_error, bad_request, payload_too_large).

panels.title: Concurrency
panels.description: Client requests waiting for response headers, and requests pending on each upstream.

panels.title: Routes (selected range)
panels.description: Per route template over the selected time range: average request rate, p95 latency and the share of 4xx / 5xx responses.

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (rate(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route) (rate(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (route) (rate(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

(sum by (route) (rate(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route) (rate(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (route) (rate(jmp_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Upstream summary
panels.description: One row per upstream. Health (UP, DOWN, or REMOVED for a server a reload removed or disabled), in-flight requests and token age are current; rate, p95 latency and failure share cover the selected range (failures = 5xx answers plus transport errors).

targets.expr: max by (server) (jmp_upstream_up{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} and on(instance, server) jmp_upstream_configured{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} == 1) or (max by (server) (jmp_upstream_configured{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"}) == 0) - 1

(sum by (server) (rate(jmp_upstream_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server", status_class=~"5xx|error"}[$__range])) or sum by (server) (rate(jmp_upstream_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (server) (rate(jmp_upstream_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Upstream p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile upstream time to response headers, per server.

panels.title: Requests per upstream (range)
panels.description: Requests sent to each upstream in the selected range.

panels.title: Failed upstream requests (range)
panels.description: 5xx answers plus transport errors per upstream in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (server) (increase(jmp_upstream_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server", status_class=~"5xx|error"}[$__range])) or sum by (server) (jmp_upstream_up{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} and on(instance, server) jmp_upstream_configured{instance=~"$instance", server=~"$server"} == 1) * 0

panels.title: Upstream errors & logins
panels.description: Per interval: connection-level failures to upstreams by kind (connect, dns, tls, timeout, body, other), and the logins the proxy made to upstreams (startup, token expiry, re-auth after a 401). Empty while every upstream is reachable and tokens are valid.

panels.title: Proxy time per request, by stage
panels.description: Average time each internal pipeline stage adds per client request (auth, id_decode, fanout, rewrite, merge, dedupe, sort_page, serialize, views_build). The stack height is the proxy's own share of a request's latency.

panels.title: Fan-out: wait for the slowest upstream
panels.description: How long merged requests waited for their slowest upstream (histogram buckets).

panels.title: Fan-out results
panels.description: Per-upstream results of fan-out calls: success, http_error, timeout, error, skipped.

panels.title: Partial fan-out responses
panels.description: Merged responses served with results from only some upstreams (one was down or failed), per interval and endpoint.

panels.title: Throughput by upstream
panels.description: Bytes per second streamed to clients, stacked by the upstream that served them.

panels.title: Streams by kind
panels.description: Finished streams per second by kind: direct (static file), hls_segment, hls_playlist, transcode, image, download, web, other.

panels.title: Time to first byte
panels.description: Time from the upstream request to the first body byte, all stream kinds (histogram buckets).

panels.title: Stream outcomes
panels.description: How streams ended: complete, client_disconnect (player stopped or seeked away), upstream_error.

panels.title: Seeking & HLS
panels.description: Range requests (seeking / resuming direct play), HLS segment requests and HLS playlists rewritten to point at the proxy.

panels.title: Merged lists: items in vs out
panels.description: Items received from upstreams for merged lists versus items returned to clients (after dedupe and paging), and duplicates removed.

panels.title: Duplicates by match key
panels.description: Which key matched the removed duplicates: tmdb, imdb, tvdb, title, index (episode split across servers), name.

panels.title: Dedupe winners (range)
panels.description: Which upstream's copy was kept when duplicates were merged (lowest priority wins), over the selected range.

panels.title: Id lookups
panels.description: Proxy id lookups from client requests: hit, view (library view id), miss (unknown id, e.g. stale client cache), invalid (malformed). Table sizes are in the upstream summary.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of catalog cache lookups answered from cache. Red under 50 %, orange under 80 %.

panels.title: Cache lookups
panels.description: Catalog cache lookups per second: hit, miss, stale (expired or forced refresh).

panels.title: Catalog refresh time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of catalog refresh calls to each upstream.

panels.title: Cache by upstream
panels.description: Catalog cache per upstream: entries held, approximate size, and time since the last successful refresh (orange after 10 min, red after 1 h).

panels.title: Refresh failures & evictions
panels.description: Bars: failed catalog refreshes per upstream per interval (left axis). Line: cache entries evicted per second (right axis); steady evictions are normal TTL churn.

panels.title: Proxy logins
panels.description: Client logins to the proxy per interval: success, bad_password, unknown_user, bad_request. Bursts of failures may mean password guessing.

panels.title: Client token checks
panels.description: Access-token checks on client requests: valid, invalid (unknown/expired token), missing, anonymous (public routes).

panels.title: Password hashing (argon2 p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile argon2 time per operation (hash at config load, verify at login). High values slow logins.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Proxy version and git commit (jmp_build_info).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the proxy process started.

panels.title: Config applied
panels.description: When the current config was (re)loaded.

panels.title: Upstreams configured
panels.description: Enabled [[server]] entries in the config.

panels.title: Config reloads
panels.description: Config reload attempts per interval: success, unchanged (file touched, same content), error (invalid file: the previous config stays active).

panels.title: Upstream changes on reload
panels.description: [[server]] changes applied by hot reloads: added, removed, rebuilt (URL changed), changed (TLS/credentials/timeout in place).

panels.title: Backends
panels.description: Backends serving requests, removed/rebuilt backends still draining in-flight streams, and requests for ids of removed servers (410 Gone).

panels.title: TLS certificates
panels.description: Every certificate the proxy has loaded (listener, upstream:<name> client certificates) with its expiry. Days left: orange under 14, red under 7.

panels.title: TLS reloads
panels.description: Certificate/key/CA reloads per interval by target (listener, upstream) and outcome. Errors keep the previous certificate.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU time used by the proxy process (1 = one full core).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the proxy process.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Open file descriptors (sockets, files) of the proxy process.

panels.title: Tokio runtime
panels.description: Alive async tasks and tasks waiting in the global queue (a growing queue means the runtime is saturated).
